Name: KEY_ASSIGN_PARAM_ST
Description: Default control bindings. Each row is a game action and holds its default keyboard key and mouse button, each with an optional modifier key.

Fields.Name: Keyboard: Modifier Key ID
Fields.Description: Modifier key held together with the keyboard key for the action.

Fields.Name: Keyboard: Key ID
Fields.Description: Default keyboard key (physical key) for the action.

Fields.Name: Mouse: Modifier Key ID
Fields.Description: Modifier key held together with the mouse button for the action.

Fields.Name: Mouse: Key ID
Fields.Description: Default mouse button (physical button) for the action.
